notes: The rematch remix system as data (NP_04 s6): operators applied as a layer over the original PBN at load. The original pattern is never edited - the sim duplicates it and applies the ops; the original keeps its Scout Book page and the remix earns its own. Operators: feint(Sx) - the string gains a feint variant (the tell plays; the attack comes `ms` late, or cancels into another string's actions), taken with probability `pct`, always once the string is burned; tighten(Sx, ms) - the tell shortened, floored at NP_04 s1's fair minimums by class; reweight - SELECT redistribution; newstring - one authored string added; phase_shift - a phase trigger moved earlier; burn(Sx, after) - NP_04 s4: after `after` interrupts of Sx in a segment he only feints it; directive - any phase-directive line executed at load (the same vocabulary the phase scripts use). Story rematches use 2-3 operators (NP_04 s6); the records here follow the roster's remix plans (NP_04A) and are first drafts.
